design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (prescription_fills_and_refills, category rx)

[Step 0 — draw] `draw_counts.py <diff> --task 1` printed {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 5]}. Assignment (round 2): rx_ext_controlled_balance_decline_credit = 6, rx_ext_theft_replacement_days (root) = 5, rx_ext_label_error_remake_units = 4.

[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: rx_ext_strength_error_remake_units, rx_ext_open_balance_decline_credit, rx_ext_vacation_override_days and their three tools. Claimed here (disjoint): lost-or-stolen replacement days (rx_refill, fill_reason lost_or_stolen_replacement), relabel remake units (rx_error_remake, wrong_directions_label only — task 0 owns wrong_strength), controlled decline credit (rx_balance_cancelled for Schedule V/III-IV/II — task 0 owns the non-controlled classes), tools record_theft_replacement_refill_fbe8d6a8, dispense_label_error_remake_88d3ae78, decline_controlled_owed_balance_a6435942 (owner user). After this task every extended policy is claimed exactly once; nothing is reserved. The theft policy's overwrite of the police-report sentence of rx_evt_early_fill_exceptions (extended to any replacement of 30+ days) is what retires that caller-statement gate for all refills of the difficulty.

[Design thesis] Surface goal: 'my pregabalin was stolen Monday, replace it today'. Core scored parameter: days_supply_dispensed of the replacement (plus the verbatim police report number). Hidden chain: the stolen September 11 refill was short with 20 capsules still owed; a confirmed mislabeled-directions report on the August refill (collected by his wife) has no remake. Rule sentences: 'The theft replacement days supply is fixed only after every confirmed mislabeled-directions report on the prescription is matched by a corrected remake on the ledger.' and 'A lost-or-stolen replacement refill is not dispensed until the fill it replaces carries no open owed balance, its owed units having been completed or cancelled on the ledger.' Breadth: coverage plan class, paid-claim history and claim reversal deadline (other difficulty), delivery plan (other difficulty), Savings Club vs Discount Card (other difficulty), 12-month early-refill history, refills account, pickup dates, owed ledger, error-report dates and outcomes.

[Problem-tree card]
root rx_ext_theft_replacement_days (agent)
 edge 1 -> rx_ext_label_error_remake_units: value_input, gate remake_on_hand_days, form state, affirmative 'The theft replacement days supply is fixed only after every confirmed mislabeled-directions report on the prescription is matched by a corrected remake on the ledger.' Four-point test: connective 'only after', record-visible state (a remake entry naming each confirmed label report), no tool/id/code token, scope exactly the confirmed label reports. Only the relabel remake policy answers a wrong_directions_label report. False at opening: rx_error_reports.66d032a9….review_outcome = confirmed, the only remake b0fa24c0… names the short-count report 16adead7…. The remake's capsules are medication the patient then holds, so the replacement takes them off: skip -> 15 instead of 8.
 edge 2 -> rx_ext_controlled_balance_decline_credit: state_gate, gate rx_fills.source_fill_id, negated 'A lost-or-stolen replacement refill is not dispensed until the fill it replaces carries no open owed balance, its owed units having been completed or cancelled on the ledger.' For a Schedule V prescription the only policy write that closes an owed balance is the controlled decline (owner user). False at opening: rx_fills.5206ee68….owed_units = 20, named by no completion/cancellation. The cancelled capsules are never added back (the theft rule says so), so the edge gates dispensing and leaves the days supply at 8.
 topological order: remake, decline, replacement; the prerequisites commute (swapped replay: identical hash a943d686…). Owner=user problem: the decline.

[Base-invariant card] rx_refill (step 16): active; refills_remaining 1; within validity; refill_not_too_soon routine-only (a routine refill would wait to 2026-09-27); lost_stolen_replacement_allowed true for Schedule V, rx_msr_lost_replacements_365d 0 < 1, police report number stated verbatim (1260921447), replacement consumes one refill; 8 days >= min_days_supply_per_fill 7. rx_error_remake (step 12): error_confirmed on 66d032a9…. rx_balance_cancelled (step 14): one_settlement_per_balance on 5206ee68….

[Business-object card] Prescription 2c0ca69a… (pregabalin 75 mg capsule, rx 1740952, Schedule V). Replaced fill = most recent refill c592b53e… (2026-09-11, 40 of 60, owed entry 5206ee68… 20, a pending short-count report on it). Mislabeled fill 42399fd5… (2026-08-12, 50 of 60, owed 10 completed 2026-08-18, collected by a caregiver). Earlier short refill 18f3557f… / 51815bc6… completed. Short-count report 16adead7… answered by b0fa24c0… and not a label error. Plan claims belong to this prescription.

[Factor card]
 L1 lost_days_anchor (method): pickup 2026-09-12 after dispensing 2026-09-11 -> 8; baseline 7 -> 7. L2 early_refill_restraint: one vacation override d99c54ee… -> 3 -> 11. L3 plan_bridge (parameter, multi-source over the plan record and the claims ledger, cross-difficulty coverage): 1 override allowed AND 5 paid claims -> 3 -> 5. L4 renewal_bridge: 1 refill left -> 5 -> 3. L5 handover_buffer (cross-difficulty delivery): Delivery Pass Monthly may deliver controlled substances -> 2 -> 6. Remake days (value input) 7. Whole baseline 0 (7 lost days less 7 remake days). Result 8.
 RL1 held_units_basis (method): report 22 days after pickup (> 14) -> 6; baseline 50 -> 58. RL2 waiting 19 days -> 2 -> 10. RL3 continuity 1 refill left -> 1 -> 12. RL4 short-fill 10 owed < 50 -> 1 -> 12. Whole baseline 50. Result 14.
 C1 controlled_unpaid_method (method, multi-source, cross-difficulty coverage/copay): insurance + Commercial Copay -> whole-week 3.50 (the Discount Card is the near-miss for the Savings Club tier); baseline 5.00 -> 6.00. C2 count hold 13 days -> 1.50 -> 6.00. C3 rebill within the plan's 14-day reversal deadline -> 0.25 -> 4.75. C4 repeat three owed entries -> 2.00 -> 2.50. C5 history 5 fills -> 0.25 -> 4.25. C6 count amount, pending short-count report on the short fill -> 0.50 -> 4.00. Whole baseline 5.00. Result 4.50.
 Overwrites declared: theft policy replaces the police-report sentence of rx_evt_early_fill_exceptions; controlled decline replaces 'a fill that was dispensed correctly is never taken back or refunded, whatever the reason the patient gives.' of rx_evt_dispensing_error. No other base sentence is departed from: the theft rule states that cancelled owed units stay undispensed, as rx_evt_partial_fill provides.

[Seed] customer, store, prescriber, one Schedule V prescription, 18 fill-ledger rows, 3 error reports (confirmed short count answered, confirmed label report unanswered, pending short count), Commercial Copay Plan with 5 paid claims, Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly, Kestrel Rx Discount Card. Automatic clauses: the September owed balance window runs to 2026-09-25; nothing waits in will-call; one refill remains; no expiry near; the pending report awaits pharmacist review and is not acted on.

[Persona] Desmond Carrow, clipped and stressed; volunteers only the stolen-medication replacement; phone to locate, DOB when asked, police report number when asked; decline and label reactions only after the agent raises them; runs the decline tool with the values handed over; closes when told the replacement is booked.

[Standard solution] locate -> verify -> read prescription, fills, error reports, coverage plan, paid claims, delivery plan, copay enrollments, store, prescriber -> relabel remake 14 -> hand over the controlled decline, patient runs it with 4.50 -> replacement 8 days with police report 1260921447.

[Verification] scratch verify.py (handling-time replay with the real tools and the check_compute evaluator) printed: relabel remake 14 (58/10/12/12, all 50); controlled credit 4.5 (6.0/6.0/4.75/2.5/4.25/4.0, all 5.0); replacement 8 (7/11/5/3/6, all 0; skip remake 15; skip decline 8). Per-task gates --task 1 all OK.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the KB prose, tool schemas, finder returns and persona alone: the theft request selects the lost-or-stolen replacement; its rule names a confirmed label report awaiting remake and an open owed balance on the replaced fill; the remake and the patient's decline come first in either order; values follow the ladders above; no second reading found.

[Difficulty-level closure] Tasks 0 and 1 claim 3 + 3 = all 6 extended policies and 6 task tools, pairwise disjoint; every policy fires in exactly one computation at its GT call.

[Round 2 rework — audit policy_task r1 items G-2, G-4, G-5, T1-1..T1-4]
 G-2 / T1-1 symptom: the theft balance-days tier added back declined, credited owed capsules (25 vs 15). Change: balance_days removed; the rule now says 'The replacement never brings back owed units that were cancelled: a cancelled balance stays undispensed.' The decline edge became a state_gate ('is not dispensed until the fill it replaces carries no open owed balance'); the value_input edge is now the relabel remake, whose capsules are on-hand medication taken off the replacement. Re-run: 8 days; there is no second reading because no tier touches the cancelled units.
 G-4 / T1-2 symptom: the controlled method's cash tier equalled the unit proportion. Change: tiers are now insurance + Commercial Copay whole-week, discount program + Savings Club value list, otherwise unit proportion (three distinct methods, each non-fall-through tier combining the fill with another product's record). Added controlled_rebill_amount (the plan's claim_reversal_deadline_days) and controlled_count_amount (pending/confirmed reports on the short fill) to reach the drawn 6. Seed: Kestrel Rx Discount Card (near-miss) and a pending short-count report on the September refill.
 G-5 / T1-3 / T1-4 symptom: report-channel, collector, repeat-error and ID-check allowances. Change: all struck. The relabel remake now uses held units, waiting, continuity (refills left) and short-fill allowances (4, the drawn count); the August fill was reseeded as a 50-of-60 short fill with 10 owed completed 2026-08-18 and the report moved to 2026-09-04 / review 2026-09-05. The theft replacement gained handover_buffer (cross-difficulty delivery; Delivery Pass Monthly seeded) and keeps anchor, restraint, plan bridge, renewal bridge (5, the drawn count).
 Propagation: computations (expected 14 / 4.50 / 8, factor_trace, factor_sensitivity, baseline_result), call arguments and tracing, two new read nodes (delivery plans, copay enrollments) shifting write steps to 12/14/16, solvability steps and seed_consistency, prerequisite_closure edges/order/load-bearing, and this dossier.
user_scenario:
You are Desmond Carrow, 54, a building contractor in Seattle. You are short-tempered today and talk in clipped sentences, because your backpack was stolen on the bus on Monday with your pregabalin in it and your nerve pain has been bad since. You call Kestrel to get the stolen pregabalin replaced today so you can pick it up at the Wedgwood store after work. That is the whole of what you want: a replacement for the capsules that were stolen. You want the pharmacy to sort the replacement out for you; you have no idea how they decide how much they can give.

You give your phone number, 2065550167, so they can find you. Asked to confirm your identity, you give your date of birth, 1971-11-02; only if they need more, your ZIP code 98115 or your email desmond.carrow@proton.me. You filed a police report on Monday; when the agent asks for the report number you read it out exactly: 1260921447. If they ask for the prescription number, it is 1740952. If they ask what was taken, it was the bottle you picked up earlier this month and it was stolen on Monday the 21st. If they ask about collecting, you will come to the counter yourself with your driver's licence after five today.

You do not raise anything else about your account. If the agent brings up the phone call you made earlier this month about the directions printed on the August bottle your wife collected for you, you say yes, the label was wrong, and you are fine with them making up a correctly labelled one. If the agent explains that the capsules the store still owed you on the stolen fill have to be either handed out or declined before the replacement can be worked out, you say you are not chasing those, decline them and give you back whatever that is worth; when the agent unlocks that decline step and hands it to you with the owed-balance reference and the credit amount, you run it yourself with exactly those values and can repeat what it showed you. If a number the agent gives you sounds off, you only ask them to check it again against the records; you never offer a figure of your own.

When the agent confirms the replacement has been booked and will be ready today, you say thanks, you will be there after five, and you hang up.

base_preconditions.condition: A refill is dispensed only while the prescription is in active status.
A refill is dispensed only when the prescription's refills_remaining is at least 1.
A refill is dispensed no later than the date the prescriber wrote the prescription plus the prescription validity days, counted in calendar days with the written date as day 0.
A routine refill is dispensed no earlier than the refill-eligible date, which is the most recent dispensed fill of this prescription plus the refill-eligibility days.

A lost_or_stolen_replacement refill is dispensed only where lost_stolen_replacement_allowed is true (Schedule V: true) and rx_msr_lost_replacements_365d (0) is below lost_stolen_max_per_365_days (1); its police-report sentence is replaced by the theft replacement policy, which requires the number here (Schedule V requires it).

edges.condition: The owed-balance entry booked for the replaced refill is named as source by a balance completion or balance cancellation entry.
edges.policy_source: A lost-or-stolen replacement refill is not dispensed until the fill it replaces carries no open owed balance, its owed units having been completed or cancelled on the ledger.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The decline books a cancellation naming the owed entry for 20 capsules, so the replaced fill carries no open owed balance and the replacement may be dispensed; the cancelled capsules are not added back.

edges.condition: For every wrong_directions_label report on the prescription whose review_outcome is confirmed, the fill ledger holds a remake entry whose error_report_id names that report.
edges.policy_source: The theft replacement days supply is fixed only after every confirmed mislabeled-directions report on the prescription is matched by a corrected remake on the ledger.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites commute: the relabel remake reads the error reports, the August fill, its pickup entry, its owed-balance entry and the refills used, none of which the decline changes (the decline adds a cancellation naming the September entry); the controlled decline credit reads the latest owed-balance entry, the short fill, owed-balance and fill counts, the reports naming the short fill and the plan, none of which the remake entry (neither refill, original fill nor owed-balance entry) changes.
